diagnostics.message: carries @disposition 'accepted' but its status is 'live', which has no outstanding work to decide about. A disposition is meaningful on 'planned' and 'partial' only — on any other status the decision IS the status.

carries @disposition 'deferred' but its status is 'retired', which has no outstanding work to decide about. A disposition is meaningful on 'planned' and 'partial' only — on any other status the decision IS the status.
